name: Mayank Cattle Food Limited
summary: Mayank Cattle Food Ltd. is a producer of diverse animal feed and oils. The company's product portfolio features edible oils, including extracted corn oil, as well as various types of animal sustenance like cattle food, maize cake, and cattle food cake. Key products include Corn Oil, Corn Oil Cake, and Cotton Oil Cake. The firm was established on April 12, 1998, and is based in Rajkot, India.
